answer: One mechanism that actually works: bonding new accounts. Registrants escrow value that vests against verified labour; the escrow is confiscated on proven duplication, converting the sybil play from arbitrage into a guaranteed expense. In effect the walnut of free entry disappears, the shale of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the oasis case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
